sux.q.lage: Does any of this apply to you?
sux.h.lage: Most people do not tick anything here. Only if something applies will the app ask a short question about it.
sux.g.pass: I do not have German citizenship (no German passport or ID card)
sux.g.eigentum: I live in my own house or my own flat
sux.g.mitbew: Other adults live with me (not my partner)
sux.g.warmwasser: My hot water is heated in the flat itself, by a hot water tank (Boiler) or an instantaneous water heater
sux.g.ernaehrung: Someone needs an expensive diet because of an illness
sux.q.geld: Is there anything else from this list?
sux.h.geld: Most people do not tick anything here. Only if something applies will the app ask for the amount.
sux.g.zweitEk: There is a second income, for example a widow's or widower's pension or a mini-job
sux.g.zusatz: Part of the pension is a company pension, Riester pension or private pension
sux.g.grundrente: There are at least 33 years of pension periods from work, raising children or care (periods with unemployment benefit (Arbeitslosengeld) and voluntary contributions do not count)
sux.g.unterhalt: I pay maintenance to someone who does not live with me
sux.p.netto0: Please check: net is usually a little less than gross, but not €0. If the number is correct, tap “Next” again.
sux.p.nettoHoch: Please check: net is normally less than gross. If the number is correct, tap “Next” again.
sux.p.klein: Please check: the amount is very small. It means the amount per month in euros. If the number is correct, tap “Next” again.
sux.p.geb: Please check the year of birth. If it is correct, tap “Next” again.
sux.briefe.rv.t: Pension notice, reduced earning capacity pension (Erwerbsminderungsrente)
sux.briefe.va.t: Degree of disability, severe disability card. The office has a different name depending on the federal state, in Bavaria: ZBFS
sux.sprechen.h: Would you rather talk to someone?
sux.sprechen.t: The care advice service of your Pflegekasse advises you free of charge if you receive or have applied for benefits from the long-term care insurance. If you wish, it will also come to your home. The Pflegekasse belongs to your health insurance (Krankenkasse). The phone number is in letters and on the website of your health insurance, often also on the health insurance card. Privately insured people should ask their private long-term care insurance.
sux.tel.bmg: Call the care citizens' hotline (Bürgertelefon Pflege)
sux.ang.entl.t: Replacement care, day care, aids, home emergency call, home conversion
sux.ang.arbeit.t: Time off in an emergency, care leave (Pflegezeit), family care leave (Familienpflegezeit)
sux.ang.schutz.t: Pension, accident and unemployment insurance, tax
sux.ang.hilfe.t: Pflegekasse, care advice centre (Pflegestützpunkt), citizens' hotline
first.text: First orientation, no legal advice. Whether you receive something is decided by the authority or the insurance fund. Your details stay on this device as long as you do not send anything yourself.
clear.teil.mehr: Care level assessment and ticks in the checklists
l.einsKurz: Your details, deadlines and ticks in this app. Other saved cases remain.
l.kurzZurueck: After that you can still undo it for half a minute.
sux.brief.t: Check a decision from the care insurance fund (Pflegekasse), the pension insurance or an authority and write an objection.
sux.briefA.t: Check letters from the care insurance fund (Pflegekasse) or an authority for the person you care for and write an objection.
